name: construchain-vision
description: Analyze authorized BIM model properties and create dashboards in ConstruChain Vision.

interface.longDescription: Discover BIM models available to your ConstruChain Vision account, inspect their property schema, and analyze model data with bounded read-only queries. Create dashboards when requested. Requires a Vision account with access to processed models. Access is limited to the workspace and projects authorized for your connection.
defaultPrompt: List the BIM models I can analyze.
Show the property schema of the model I select.
Summarize quantities using the model's actual properties.

review.commerce_description: The integration does not process payments. An existing ConstruChain Vision account and applicable service access are required.

positive.prompt: List the BIM models I can analyze.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only models available to the connected account.

positive.prompt: Show the actual property schema for a model I select from the list.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the selected model using the real model identifier returned by discovery.

positive.prompt: Count distinct elements in the selected model.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the actual property schema and a bounded SELECT query.

positive.prompt: Summarize an available numeric property by category in the selected model.
positive.expected_behavior: Use available properties, safe numeric conversion and bounded results; report missing properties.

positive.prompt: Create a workspace dashboard from the analysis we just completed.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the requested dashboard from the authorized analysis and explain its actual visibility.

negative.prompt: Change geometry in my BIM model.
Read models from a workspace I cannot access.
Explain how BIM quantity analysis works without accessing or publishing my data.

publication.release_notes: Initial public directory submission: discover authorized BIM models, inspect schemas, run bounded read-only property queries, and create dashboards on request. Includes native IFC property support without an Autodesk account and scoped OAuth.
